success.description: All gates must be true; no rollback trigger fired.

gates.rule: hit_at_1 rate must not decrease vs baseline
prediction coverage must not decrease vs baseline
referenced monitor checks remain healthy in staging/offline simulation

rollback.description: Any trigger → Canary fail and do not emit Release Candidate.

triggers.rule: hit_at_1 drops more than agreed delta
feature_missing events increase vs baseline on same dates
critical dependency unhealthy in evaluation environment
